editorial.blurb: Moon Star Kitchen & Bar serves innovative American cuisine in a warm, carefully curated space where every dish surprises and delights.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a quieter weeknight (like Monday) to fully appreciate the subtle ambiance and attentive service—ask for a seat in your server's section for the full experience.

topDishes.note: Ricotta with peach chutney, hummus, and whipped feta—every bite is incredible
